in_marathi.name: Lalitkant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalitkant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalitkant is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lalita' meaning 'playful', 'light' or 'movement' and 'Kant' meaning 'power'. In Hindu mythology, Lalitkant is an aspect of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the divine power of creation, preservation, and destruction.

vedic_reference.note: Lalitkant is a name derived from the Vedic Goddess Lajjā, who is known for her kindness, grace, and beauty. She is also the wife of Vishnu, and is believed to grant her devotees' desires. The name Lalitkant is a combination of Lajjā (easily pleased) and Kant (God), reflecting the divine qualities of being kind, graceful, and godly.
